1.asv: Moreover Jehovah answered Job, and said,

2.web: “Shall he who argues contend with the Almighty? He who argues with God, let him answer it.”
2.asv: Shall he that cavilleth contend with the Almighty? He that argueth with God, let him answer it.

3.asv: Then Job answered Jehovah, and said,

4.web: “Behold, I am of small account. What shall I answer you? I lay my hand on my mouth.
4.asv: Behold, I am of small account; what shall I answer thee? I lay my hand upon my mouth.

5.web: I have spoken once, and I will not answer; Yes, twice, but I will proceed no further.”
5.asv: Once have I spoken, and I will not answer; Yea, twice, but I will proceed no further.

6.web: Then Yahweh answered Job out of the whirlwind,
6.asv: Then Jehovah answered Job out of the whirlwind, and said,

7.web: “Now brace yourself like a man. I will question you, and you will answer me.
7.asv: Gird up thy loins now like a man: I will demand of thee, and declare thou unto me.

8.web: Will you even annul my judgment? Will you condemn me, that you may be justified?
8.asv: Wilt thou even annul my judgment? Wilt thou condemn me, that thou mayest be justified?

9.web: Or do you have an arm like God? Can you thunder with a voice like him?
9.asv: Or hast thou an arm like God? And canst thou thunder with a voice like him?

10.web: “Now deck yourself with excellency and dignity. Array yourself with honor and majesty.
10.asv: Deck thyself now with excellency and dignity; And array thyself with honor and majesty.

11.web: Pour out the fury of your anger. Look at everyone who is proud, and bring him low.
11.asv: Pour forth the overflowings of thine anger; And look upon every one that is proud, and abase him.

12.web: Look at everyone who is proud, and humble him. Crush the wicked in their place.
12.asv: Look on every one that is proud, and bring him low; And tread down the wicked where they stand.

13.web: Hide them in the dust together. Bind their faces in the hidden place.
13.asv: Hide them in the dust together; Bind their faces in the hiddenplace.

14.web: Then I will also admit to you that your own right hand can save you.
14.asv: Then will I also confess of thee That thine own right hand can save thee.

15.web: “See now, behemoth, which I made as well as you. He eats grass as an ox.
15.asv: Behold now, behemoth, which I made as well as thee; He eateth grass as an ox.

16.web: Look now, his strength is in his thighs. His force is in the muscles of his belly.
16.asv: Lo now, his strength is in his loins, And his force is in the muscles of his belly.

17.web: He moves his tail like a cedar. The sinews of his thighs are knit together.
17.asv: He moveth his tail like a cedar: The sinews of his thighs are knit together.

18.web: His bones are like tubes of brass. His limbs are like bars of iron.
18.asv: His bones areastubes of brass; His limbs are like bars of iron.

19.web: He is the chief of the ways of God. He who made him gives him his sword.
19.asv: He is the chief of the ways of God: Heonlythat made him giveth him his sword.

20.web: Surely the mountains produce food for him, where all the animals of the field play.
20.asv: Surely the mountains bring him forth food, Where all the beasts of the field do play.

21.web: He lies under the lotus trees, in the covert of the reed, and the marsh.
21.asv: He lieth under the lotus-trees, In the covert of the reed, and the fen.

22.web: The lotuses cover him with their shade. The willows of the brook surround him.
22.asv: The lotus-trees cover him with their shade; The willows of the brook compass him about.

23.web: Behold, if a river overflows, he doesn’t tremble. He is confident, though the Jordan swells even to his mouth.
23.asv: Behold, if a river overflow, he trembleth not; He is confident, though a Jordan swell even to his mouth.

24.web: Shall any take him when he is on the watch, or pierce through his nose with a snare?
24.asv: Shall any take him when he is on the watch, Or pierce through his nose with a snare?
